### Port 2994

[Port 2994](https://www.speedguide.net/port.php?port=2994) appears to be [Veritas DBMS](https://www.veritas.com/support/en\_US/article.100030430). I cannot seem to find anything specific to that portion of Veritas. To be safe I try the [same exploits](austin02.md#veritas) I tried on `AUSTIN02` but they fail here too.
